SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
SELECT
  now()::text AS checked_at,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
     SELECT tipo_followup::text AS tipo, status::text AS status,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(error_msg, ''), '-') AS motivo, count(*)::int AS n
     FROM scheduled_followups
     WHERE COALESCE(processed_at, scheduled_at) >= now() - interval '24 hours'
     GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 2, 1) t) AS followups_24h,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
     SELECT lm.phone, COALESCE(lm.conversation_id::text, '-') AS conversation_id,
            lm.updated_at::text
     FROM lead_memory lm
     WHERE upper(COALESCE(lm.conversation_state, '')) = 'LOSS_REASON_PENDING'
       AND lm.updated_at < now() - interval '24 hours'
     ORDER BY lm.updated_at ASC LIMIT 20) t) AS loss_reason_stuck,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
     SELECT workflow_name, count(*)::int AS n, max(occurred_at)::text AS last_at
     FROM workflow_errors
     WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
     GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10) t) AS workflow_errors_24h,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
     SELECT tipo_evento, COALESCE(datos_evento->>'reason', '-') AS reason, count(*)::int AS n
     FROM eventos_conversacion
     WHERE tipo_evento IN ('PRICING_SENT', 'PRICING_SKIPPED')
       AND created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
       AND COALESCE(datos_evento->>'qa_seed', '') <> 'true'
     GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC LIMIT 10) t) AS pricing_events_24h,
  -- POST_PRICING_MONITOR_BASELINE: ignore the repaired rollout incident and watch new regressions.
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
     SELECT e.conversacion_id::text AS conversation_id,
            e.created_at::text AS created_at,
            e.estado_nuevo::text AS new_state,
            COALESCE(e.metadata->>'source', '-') AS source,
            COALESCE(e.metadata->>'last_response_type', '-') AS last_response_type
     FROM eventos_conversacion e
     WHERE e.tipo = 'CAMBIO_ESTADO'
       AND e.estado_anterior::text = 'QUOTED'
       AND e.estado_nuevo::text IN (
         'NEW_LEAD', 'CONTACTED_1', 'CONTACTED_2', 'CONTACTED_3',
         'ENGAGED', 'VEHICLE_SELECTION', 'VALUE_PRESENTED'
       )
       AND e.created_at > GREATEST(
         now() - interval '24 hours',
         timestamptz '2026-08-06 21:05:44+00'
       )
       AND COALESCE(e.metadata->>'source', '') NOT IN (
         'manual_repair_post_pricing_state_guard', 'qa_n8n_seed'
       )
       AND COALESCE(e.metadata->>'last_response_type', '') <> 'REVIEW_OTHER_PLAN'
     ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
     LIMIT 20) t) AS post_pricing_state_regressions_24h;
